name: new_bench_short_summaries
description: A collection of short textual summaries describing mathematical benchmarks intended for use with retrieval-augmented systems (RAG) and dataset discovery. The entries provide concise descriptions of benchmark scope, difficulty, and key features to support retrieval, meta-evaluation, and selection of math tasks for downstream experiments.
reputation: A small, project-specific dataset used within the RAG4Math project; limited broader adoption.
